version: v1.1 — 2026-10-21 — 클립 검수(사용자 지시 "클립 돌렸으니 확인해서 영상 만들어봐"): S09 use_from 0.3·use_to 1.5·loop pingpong · S10 use_from 0.3·use_to 1.0·loop pingpong — 클립 안 겹침·녹아내림 구간을 빼고 씀(tools/assemble_video.py v1.1, 선명도 검사 + 눈으로 확인). 이전 v1.0 — 2026-10-19 — 쇼츠 v2.0 11문장 중 사연 장면 7개를 세로 AI 클립으로 (1문장 = 썸네일 그림 K.cover, 4·8·11 = 코드 화면: 숫자·계산·롱폼 안내). 인물·그림체는 롱폼 계획을 그대로 (inherit)

clips.name: S02
clips.ko: 59세 퇴직 — 짐 상자를 들고 회사를 나서는 김 씨 (세로)
clips.image: Daytime in front of an office building's glass doors (no signs). Mr. Kim walks out toward the viewer carrying a cardboard box of his belongings — a small potted plant, a mug and a photo frame — and glances back at the building with a bittersweet expression. Vertical full-body shot, his face in the upper-middle of the frame.
clips.motion: Mr. Kim walks out through the glass door toward the camera carrying the box and glances back over his shoulder at the building; the plant leaves sway in a light breeze; static camera.
clips.ghost_ok: 김 씨가 오른쪽 화면 밖으로 걸어 나감 (2026-10-21 그림 확인)

clips.name: S03
clips.ko: 퇴직한 다음 달, 공단 창구에서 신청서에 서명하는 김 씨 (세로)
clips.image: At a pension office counter, Mr. Kim signs a blank form with a pen, about to slide it under the glass partition; a clerk's hand reaches out from the other side. Mr. Kim looks calm and a little hurried. Vertical medium shot, his face in the upper-middle of the frame.
clips.motion: Mr. Kim signs the form and slides it under the glass partition; the clerk's hand takes it; static camera.

clips.name: S05
clips.ko: 64세면 돌아올 줄 — 소파에서 차를 마시며 여유로운 김 씨 (세로)
clips.image: Daytime in the living room. Mr. Kim leans back comfortably on the gray sofa holding a warm cup of tea, smiling with relaxed confidence. Soft sunlight through the curtains. Vertical medium shot, his face in the upper-middle of the frame.
clips.motion: Mr. Kim leans back on the sofa, takes a slow sip of tea and smiles contentedly; steam rises from the cup; static camera.

clips.name: S06
clips.ko: 1년 뒤 동창 모임 — 웃으며 잔을 부딪치는 친구들 (세로)
clips.image: Evening at the cozy Korean restaurant: Mr. Kim and his friend with the gray crew cut (and two other friends partly visible) laugh and clink glasses over the table with a bubbling stew pot. Vertical medium shot, faces in the upper-middle of the frame.
clips.motion: The old friends laugh and clink their glasses together while steam rises from the stew; slow push-in toward Mr. Kim and his friend.

clips.name: S07
clips.ko: 친구가 진지하게 묻고, 잔을 든 채 굳은 김 씨 (세로)
clips.image: Same restaurant, close two-shot: the friend with the gray crew cut leans in and asks something seriously with his index finger raised; Mr. Kim freezes with his glass halfway to his mouth, eyes wide, smile fading. Vertical shot, both faces in the upper-middle of the frame.
clips.motion: The friend leans in and asks seriously, raising his index finger; Mr. Kim freezes with his glass halfway up, his eyes widening as his smile fades; static camera.

clips.name: S09
clips.ko: 밤 식탁, 신청서를 내려다보며 이마를 짚고 좌절한 김 씨 (세로)
clips.image: Night at the dining table under a warm lamp. Mr. Kim looks down at a single blank application form, one hand pressed to his forehead, head bowed, brows knitted, shoulders slumped — crushed and regretful. Vertical medium shot, his face in the upper-middle of the frame.
clips.motion: Mr. Kim slowly lowers his head and rubs his forehead, letting out a long sigh as his shoulders sink; the lamp light glows softly; very slow push-in.
clips.qa: 2026-10-21 클립 검수: 1.9초부터 종이·팔이 두 겹 → 0.3~1.5초만 앞으로·거꾸로 (첫 0.25초는 시작 그림에서 넘어오는 프레임)

clips.name: S10
clips.ko: 서류 더미에서 고개를 들어 결심한 눈빛으로 앞을 보는 김 씨 (세로)
clips.image: Night at the dining table covered with blank papers and a calculator: Mr. Kim lifts his head and looks straight ahead with a questioning, determined look — he is not giving up. Vertical medium close-up, his face in the upper-middle of the frame.
clips.motion: Mr. Kim slowly raises his head from the papers and looks straight ahead, his expression changing from worry to determination; slow push-in.
clips.qa: 2026-10-21 클립 검수: 1.2초부터 팔·종이가 반투명하게 겹치고(턱 괸 자세 → 두 손을 탁자에) 2.2초부터 전등도 두 겹 → 0.3~1.0초만 앞으로·거꾸로 + 1.35배 늦춤, 나머지는 0.3초 장면 멈춤 (첫 0.25초는 색·선명도가 달라 뺌 — 그 프레임에서 멈추면 색이 바래 보였음)
